title: Ashbury Rewards Parking Savings on Self-Parking: Guest Folios Benefit and Correction Tool
content:
At brands that charge for self-parking, a stay credited to an Ashbury Rewards membership receives Ashbury Rewards parking savings on its self-parking. The night audit posts each night's self-parking at the brand's self-parking rate, and guest services posts the self-parking savings of the stay as one correction against the most recent self-parking line of the stay, with the reason that the elite benefit was not applied.

## The benefit on the Guest Folio

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Where | Ashbury brands that charge for self-parking |
| Whose stay | A stay credited to an Ashbury Rewards membership |
| How the nights are posted | Each night's self-parking at the brand's self-parking rate, by the night audit |
| How the savings reach the bill | One correction for the whole stay, posted by guest services against the most recent self-parking line of the stay |
| Reason recorded | The elite benefit was not applied |

The savings of the stay are booked once, as a single correction; the earlier self-parking lines of the stay carry no correction of their own for this benefit.

## Posting the savings: `correct_self_parking_29958fbc`

**Capability.** Guest services posts, on an open guest folio, the Ashbury Rewards parking savings the stay's self-parking charges are owed, as one correction against one self-parking charge line. One call books one adjustment line that names that self-parking charge, carries its charge code and business date, is recorded as posted by guest services today with the reason that the elite benefit was not applied, and lowers the folio balance by the amount taken off. The guest sees the correction printed under that parking charge on the bill.

**How it is invoked.** `correct_self_parking_29958fbc` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, passing the four parameters below.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `folio_id` | The reference number of the guest folio of the stay, read from the folio lookup | Id |
| `customer_id` | The reference number of the guest's profile, read from the profile lookup | Id |
| `related_posting_id` | The reference number of the self-parking charge line the correction is posted against, read from the folio line lookup | Id |
| `savings_amount` | The amount taken off | USD, 2 decimal places, always positive; rounded half up to the cent before booking |

**Return.** A receipt with `posting_id` (reference number of the new correction line), `folio_id`, `related_posting_id` (the parking charge corrected), `charge_code` (the corrected line's code), `amount` (USD to 2 decimal places, the amount taken off), `balance_due` (USD to 2 decimal places, the folio balance afterwards) and `status`, which reads "posted" when the correction stands.
